notes: Home 3D World: makes the interactive 3D Local world the default World View on Agent City Home instead of leaving it only on a separate Planet Lab page. The Home panel now embeds the read-only WebGL renderer in Local mode, keeps Region and Planet controls available inside the same view, passes 3D citizen selections back to the Home visit panel, mirrors simulation-time dawn/day/dusk/night lighting in the local scene, and retains the prior 2D map behind an explicit fallback button. The 3D surface remains presentation-only outside authoritative local meter-space and does not grant visitor control or write Simulation state.
